value.rationale: A uniform fixed-count removal experiment is a natural food-web robustness protocol. The precise minimum of five vulnerable taxa for two consumer-dependence sign reversals is a sharp structural cutoff, while its explicit two-stage trophic witness shows that indirect energy pathways can defeat one-switch intuitions valid for direct-partner systems. This is more informative than individual-species vulnerability or mean extinction-area ranking, without claiming empirical realism.
